text:
AJ (Sales): FYI handing off NewPathway — signed POC -> annual contract, $150k ARR, start-of-prod target mid-May. Main risks: procurement asked for SOC2 + on-prem option, they want SAML SSO + custom prompt templates. Contract ID: NW-2026-042. PM is Priya (NewPathway).

AJ (Sales): Key dates: kickoff week of 2026-04-20, go-live target 2026-05-15. Renewal window Mar 2027.

Marie (CS): Thanks AJ — I'm taking ownership for onboarding and renewal. @Priya (cc via email) — can you share technical contact and preferred kickoff times? I'll schedule a 60m kickoff + product enablement.

Marie (CS): Immediate next steps I have in mind:
- schedule kickoff (owner: Marie)
- enablement workshop (owner: Marie)
- SSO deep-dive with Support (owner: Leo)
- Private deployment feasibility with Eng (owner: Sam)
- Capture initial prompt templates and eval scenarios (owner: Customer + Marie)

AJ (Sales): Priya's technical contact is Mateo (mateo@newpathway.ai). Prefers afternoons PT.

OnboardBot: Onboarding checklist created for NW-2026-042 — https://redwood.example/onboard/NW-2026-042 :white_check_mark:

Marie (CS): Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-04-21 16:00 PT. I'll send invitation and attach this thread + checklist. Is everyone ok with that? :calendar: :thumbsup:

AJ (Sales): Works for client, confirmed.

Leo (Support): I'll lead the SSO session. Quick note on SAML: customer needs IdP metadata, ACS URL, and cert thumbprint. If they want private deployment, we'll need network diagrams and expected QPS.

Leo (Support): Minimal SAML metadata snippet we usually request:
```
entityID: https://idp.newpathway.ai
acs: https://app.redwood.example/saml/consume
certificate_fingerprint: SHA256:AB:CD:...:12
```

Sam (Eng): Re: private deployment — we can do a VPC-based private control plane or an on-prem bundle. To estimate effort: need to confirm GPU footprint (expected concurrency and avg tokens per request). Also check compliance notes for SOC2 packaging.

Sam (Eng): Quick questions for the kickoff so we can prepare:
- target qps / peak concurrent requests
- avg request length and max seq len
- whether they require quantized models or full FP16/TF32

Marie (CS): I'll collect those from Priya and Mateo before the kickoff. Also capturing a few enablement asks from the client: admin training, prompt-engineering session, and monitoring/alerts overview.

AJ (Sales): They mentioned initial volume small (10–20 concurrent) but expect spikes during product demos. Budget for Dedicated isn't in this year plan; private deployment is a requirement for procurement to sign.

Marie (CS): Renewal risk flag: procurement insisting on on-prem / SOC2 may delay full activation. I'll add a risk mitigation plan: 1) short-term hosted + SCC (contract clause) + SOC2 roadmap; 2) parallel private deployment evaluation as proof-of-concept.

Marie (CS): Draft mitigations and owners (for internal tracking):
- SOC2 evidence packet (owner: Marie + Security) — due 2026-04-28
- Host-to-private migration proposal (owner: Sam) — draft due 2026-05-05
- SSO enablement and checklist (owner: Leo) — complete before kickoff
- Enablement materials + session (owner: Marie) — scheduled during kickoff week

Sam (Eng): I'll start a migration proposal doc and link it into the onboarding checklist. Expect a first draft by 2026-05-04.

Leo (Support): I'll prepare the SSO playbook and a short runbook for common SAML hiccups. Also will request network diagrams from Mateo.

Marie (CS): Who will capture product feedback from the enablement session for our quality loop? I can take notes, but prefer we send an eval survey post-session.

AJ (Sales): I'll ask the client to opt in to a short feedback survey after enablement. Good to have CS-led notes + survey.

Marie (CS): Plan: kickoff invite + survey link; have Eng + Support in the guest list. I'll create an internal ticket for tracking the mitigation items and tag this thread.

OnboardBot: Internal ticket created: CS-1489 (Onboarding + SOC2 risk).

Marie (CS): Final item for now — can someone from Security drop the SOC2 evidence location or point person? If not here, I'll ping sec channel and loop back.

Sam (Eng): Noted. If Security needs infra specifics for SOC2, I'll coordinate.

Leo (Support): Ready on SSO side. I have time Thursday afternoon to sync with Mateo if needed.

AJ (Sales): Thanks everyone — leaving the day-to-day to Marie. I'll be available for exec questions. :handshake:

Marie (CS): Thanks all — I'll send invites and the pre-kickoff questionnaire today. Open items captured; will update ticket CS-1489 and post summary after kickoff.

Marie (CS): (2026-04-21 16:00 PT) Kickoff scheduled — see calendar invite.
